The supplied Table 8 program remains present but its entire 310-line body is withheld in the verified safe view. Exact CRSP market-value, acquirer/target CAR, long-term-return, innovative-acquirer, Eventus, model/output and Table 8 sample contracts remain unknown. The datasheet mentions CRSP Daily, but this review cannot establish whether Table 8 consumes it. Do not infer missing code, missing data, or service availability.

The dependency ledger identifies pre_announcement/deal_expand temporary products in Table 9 and pre_announcement in failed-bid preparation, but the retained source-evidence record does not establish the active save/consumer contract for these dynamic tempfile aliases.
The failed-bid branch reads two matched failed-bid samples and later Table 12 citation-matched samples; exact active producers, keys, and matching-branch formats remain unresolved.

The regression script consumes multiple table-specific samples from earlier branches. Except for the source-proven Figure 3 coefficient file, the retained evidence does not establish the exact active producers and field contracts for these outputs.

SAS produces Comp_control and CRSP_control products used by visible Stata branches. Export, working-library, filename, and DTA format alignment are preparation steps for the same supported products; do not add new raw-data requirements solely for those aliases.

evidence.description: The SDC preparation links the acquirer CUSIP at Date_Announced to CRSP name history.
evidence.file: Code/0.1. SDC M&A Deals with Firm ID.sas
evidence.quote:
Proc sql;
	create table MA_Acq
	as select 
	X.*, Y.permco as Acq_permco, 
	Y.permno as Acq_permno, 
	Y.NCUSIP6 as Acq_NCUSIP, 
	Y.COMNAM as Acq_COMNAM, 
	Y.link_cusip as Acq_Link_Score
	from MA_link as X
	left join crsp_name as Y
	on X.Acquirer_CUSIP=Y.NCUSIP6 and Y.date<=X.Date_Announced<=Y.NAMEENDT
	order by Acquirer_CUSIP, Date_Announced;

evidence.description: The SDC preparation links the target CUSIP at Date_Announced to CRSP name history.
evidence.file: Code/0.1. SDC M&A Deals with Firm ID.sas
evidence.quote:
Proc sql;
	create table MA_Tgt
	as select X.*, 
	Y.permco as Tgt_permco, 
	Y.permno as Tgt_permno, 
	Y.NCUSIP6 as Tgt_NCUSIP, 
	Y.COMNAM as Tgt_COMNAM, 
	Y.link_cusip as Tgt_Link_Score 
	from MA_Acq as X
	left join crsp_name as Y
	on X.Target_CUSIP=Y.NCUSIP6 and Y.date<=X.Date_Announced<=Y.NAMEENDT
	order by Target_CUSIP, Date_Announced;
